description: This file contains functions and type definitions for interacting with Microsoft Teams via Microsoft Graph API, including token resolution, fetching teams, channels, and handling Graph API requests.

methods.name: normalizeQuery
methods.description: Trims whitespace from a string or returns an empty string if null or undefined.

methods.name: escapeOData
methods.description: Escapes single quotes in a string for OData queries.

methods.name: requestGraph
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request to the Graph API with specified parameters.

methods.name: readOptionalGraphJson
methods.description: Reads JSON from a Response, returning undefined for 204 or empty responses.

methods.name: fetchGraphJson
methods.description: Fetches JSON data from Graph API given token and path.

methods.name: resolveGraphToken
methods.description: Resolves and returns an access token for Microsoft Graph API using MS Teams credentials.

methods.name: listTeamsByName
methods.description: Lists Teams filtered by display name starting with the query string.

methods.name: postGraphJson
methods.description: Sends a POST request to Graph API and returns the response JSON.

methods.name: postGraphBetaJson
methods.description: Sends a POST request to the beta version of Graph API.

methods.name: deleteGraphRequest
methods.description: Deletes a resource in Graph API.

methods.name: listChannelsForTeam
methods.description: Lists channels for a specified team.
